application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: 1.	The Council does not consider that the grounds specified by the applicant/agent (i.e. alleged improvement of tree health, cyclic crown reduction,) sufficient reason to justify the proposed works to trees which make a positive contribution to the amenity of the locality and wider borough.
description: Works to trees covered by LBE ORDER NO 14 (6) 1975: (T1) Sycamore - crown lift to 4m above ground level, remove basal growth, crown reduce by 1.5m overall, (T3) Maple - crown reduce by 1m overall, remove epicormic growth, (G2) Silver Maple x2 - crown reduce by up to 2.5m overall, crown lift to 4.5m above ground level, (G4) x1 Poplar & x1 Sycamore - re-pollard all crowns by 2m close to the previous reductions points, (G5) - x4 Mature Lime, x4 Mature Chestnut - remove all epicormic growth at base, crown reduce all by up to 2.5m, pruning cuts to be made below previous reduction points, (G5a) Maple - crown reduce by 1m overall, remove epicormic growth.
